content:
I can’t determine the most likely next items from a single purchased item ID alone. That requires transaction co-occurrence or a recommendation model trained on purchase history.

If you provide the grocery transaction dataset or item-association rules, I can compute the top 10 item IDs for item 1868.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 1868. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
